```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 14
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center

library(plotly)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

dat <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/LTER_mean_coral_and_algae_cover_by_year.csv")

cover_all <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Habitat_type = case_when(
      Habitat == "Forereef" & Depth == 10 ~ "Forereef 10m",
      Habitat == "Forereef" & Depth == 17 ~ "Forereef 17m",
      Habitat == "Fringing" ~ "Fringing",
      Habitat == "Backreef" ~ "Backreef",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Habitat_type)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Coral_percent_cover, Macroalgae_percent_cover),
    names_to = "Cover_type",
    values_to = "Percent_cover"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cover_type = if_else(Cover_type == "Coral_percent_cover", "Coral", "Macroalgae"),
    Habitat_type = factor(Habitat_type, levels = c("Forereef 10m", "Forereef 17m", "Fringing", "Backreef"))
  )


# Build plotly subplot: one panel per habitat
habitats <- c("Forereef 10m", "Forereef 17m", "Fringing", "Backreef")
sites <- sort(unique(cover_all$Site))  # LTER_1, LTER_2, ... for consistent trace order
n_sites <- length(sites)

# Create one plot per habitat (coral traces first, then algae traces per habitat)
# Trace order per habitat: coral LTER_1..LTER_6, then algae LTER_1..LTER_6
plot_list <- lapply(habitats, function(hab) {
  df_hab <- cover_all %>% filter(Habitat_type == hab) %>%
    mutate(Site = factor(Site, levels = sites))

  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(
      data = df_hab %>% filter(Cover_type == "Coral"),
      x = ~Year, y = ~Percent_cover,
      color = ~Site, colors = "Set1",
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      legendgroup = ~Site, name = ~paste(Site, "(Coral)")
    ) %>%
    add_trace(
      data = df_hab %>% filter(Cover_type == "Macroalgae"),
      x = ~Year, y = ~Percent_cover,
      color = ~Site, colors = "Set1",
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(dash = "dash"),
      legendgroup = ~Site, name = ~paste(Site, "(Macroalgae)"),
      visible = FALSE  # default to hidden; show via Cover toggle
    ) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Percent cover"),
      showlegend = (hab == habitats[1])
    )
  p
})

# Trace order: each habitat has n_sites coral + n_sites algae
n_traces_per_hab <- n_sites * 2
n_total <- length(habitats) * n_traces_per_hab

# Cover toggle visibility (all sites)
coral_visible <- rep(c(rep(TRUE, n_sites), rep(FALSE, n_sites)), length(habitats))
algae_visible <- rep(c(rep(FALSE, n_sites), rep(TRUE, n_sites)), length(habitats))
both_visible <- rep(TRUE, n_total)

# Site toggle visibility (both coral and algae for selected site)
# site_idx: NULL = all sites, 1..n_sites = single site
site_visible <- function(site_idx) {
  base <- logical(n_total)
  for (h in seq_along(habitats)) {
    offset <- (h - 1) * n_traces_per_hab
    if (is.null(site_idx)) {
      base[offset + seq_len(n_traces_per_hab)] <- TRUE
    } else {
      base[offset + site_idx] <- TRUE
      base[offset + n_sites + site_idx] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  base
}

# Default: all sites, both cover types
p_interactive <- subplot(
  plot_list,
  nrows = 2,
  margin = 0.06,
  titleY = TRUE,
  titleX = TRUE
) %>%
  layout(
    height = 800,
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 0.24, y = 1.06, text = "<b>Forereef 10m</b>", showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 16)),
      list(x = 0.76, y = 1.06, text = "<b>Forereef 17m</b>", showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 16)),
      list(x = 0.24, y = 0.48, text = "<b>Fringing</b>", showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 16)),
      list(x = 0.76, y = 0.48, text = "<b>Backreef</b>", showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 16))
    ),
    updatemenus = list(
      # Cover toggle (left)
      list(
        buttons = list(
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", coral_visible), label = "Coral only"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", algae_visible), label = "Macroalgae only"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", both_visible), label = "Both")
        ),
        direction = "down",
        showactive = TRUE,
        active = 0,  # default to "Coral only"
        x = 0.15, xanchor = "left",
        y = 1.12, yanchor = "top"
      ),
      # Site toggle (right) - note: when used, overrides cover selection (plotly limitation)
      list(
        buttons = list(
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(NULL)), label = "All sites"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(1)), label = "LTER 1"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(2)), label = "LTER 2"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(3)), label = "LTER 3"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(4)), label = "LTER 4"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(5)), label = "LTER 5"),
          list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", site_visible(6)), label = "LTER 6")
        ),
        direction = "down",
        showactive = TRUE,
        active = 0,  # default to "All sites"
        x = 0.85, xanchor = "right",
        y = 1.12, yanchor = "top"
      )
    )
  )

p_interactive
```
